core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sabahat is a Turkish-origin name meaning “Beauty, grace”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Turkish word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabahat corresponds to the Turkish form صَبَاحَة (Turkish Sabahat, from Arabic صَبَاحَة). Its core sense is sabahat; beauty, grace (turkish/urdu). Sabahat is the Turkish/Urdu form of Arabic صَبَاحَة (Ṣabāḥa) 'beauty, grace'. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave 'سبahat' (a broken Latin-Arabic mix) and labelled the origin Arabic; the name as used is Turkish/Urdu. The source gloss 'Morning, Dawn' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: صباحت
persian.long_meaning: Sabahat (صباحت) نامی برگرفته از زبان ترکی است و معنای اصلی آن صباحت، زیبایی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
